results.controlIntent: a. Identify system flaws, report system flaws, and correct system flaws; b. Test software and firmware updates related to flaw remediation for effectiveness before installation, and test those updates for potential side effects before installation; c. Within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of the release of the updates, install security-relevant software and firmware updates; and d. Incorporate flaw remediation into the organizational configuration management process.

judgment.rationale:
Evidence from two sources reveals a mixed conformance picture for SI-2.r3 (Flaw Remediation):

**Partially Satisfied — Initial Deployment:**
The model registry entry (ddf50b04) shows the model was approved at 2025-12-01T09:00Z. The CreateEndpoint CloudTrail event (b108f97c) shows deployment at 2025-12-01T11:00Z — i.e., approximately 2 hours *after* registry approval. This ordering (approve → deploy) is consistent with incorporating flaw remediation into a configuration management process (SI-2.r3.d), as the model passed through a formal approval gate before being deployed to production.

**Not Satisfied — Hotfix Deployment:**
The UpdateEndpoint CloudTrail event (e8149778) dated 2026-03-15T14:22Z shows a hotfix deployment ("churn-predictor-v1-hotfix") with no corresponding model registry entry. This means the hotfix bypassed the model registry and formal change-control process entirely. This directly violates SI-2.r3.d, which requires flaw remediation to be incorporated into the organizational configuration management process. It also raises concerns about SI-2.r3.b (testing updates for effectiveness and side effects before installation), since there is no registry record of the hotfix being reviewed or approved.

**Gaps:** There is no evidence of (1) a formal flaw identification and reporting process, (2) documented testing of updates for effectiveness or side effects prior to installation, or (3) an organization-defined time-period SLA for installing security-relevant updates (SI-2.r3.c). These gaps prevent a full assessment of all sub-requirements.
gaps: No evidence of a formal flaw identification and reporting process (SI-2.r3.a)
No evidence of pre-installation testing of updates for effectiveness or side effects (SI-2.r3.b)
No organization-defined time-period SLA for installing security-relevant updates (SI-2.r3.c)
No model registry entry or approval record for the 2026-03-15 hotfix deployment — human attestation required to determine whether an out-of-band approval process exists
No patch management or vulnerability tracking system data available to assess end-to-end flaw remediation lifecycle

payload.note: Deployed 2h BEFORE registry approval at 09:00 — change control not satisfied
Hotfix deploy — no corresponding registry entry found
